Researcher: 박준식 (PARK JOON SHIK)
Affiliation: 스마트센서연구센터
Keywords: piezoelectric micro actuators, micro and nano gas sensors, micro fluidic devices for micro TAS, flexible sensors, international standardization
Introduction: Since 1994, he has researched piezoelectric micro actuators, micro and nano gas sensors, micro fluidic devices for micro TAS, flexible sensors, and International standardizations (MEMS, Quantum Technologies) as a chief researcher at Korea Electronics Technology Institute (KETI). From August 2007 to August 2009, he researched electrical and optical properties of individual Ge nanowires synthesized using VLS mechanism as a visiting scholar at Dept. of Materials Sci. and Eng. of Standford Univ
